dogecoin.text: @carlquintanilla Carl, here is a serious question. Why do newspeople keep saying that he “commented” that Doge coin was a “hustle”, when he was just reading a silly script?  He also said “Doge coin to the moon” at the end of the sketch—a reference to the Doge coin deal?
